---
name: Outlet map entry
about: Add, change or remove an entry in data/outlets.json
title: 'Map: '
labels: map
assignees: ''
---

**Outlet name**

**Hosts involved**

List every host, one per line.

**Which change**

- [ ] alias (two registrable domains, one newsroom)
- [ ] portal base (a parent domain hosting separate newsrooms)
- [ ] article-id rule (one numeric id across section paths or slugs)
- [ ] slug outlet (sister hosts republish under a new id with the same headline)
- [ ] aggregator
- [ ] suffix
- [ ] pass-through host
- [ ] removal of an existing entry

**Evidence**

Two public URLs of the same article, or a masthead or about page showing one newsroom. Removal needs the same evidence as adding.

**Current and expected keys**

Paste `outlet-key --explain '<url>'` for one affected URL and say which key you expect.

Public facts about newsrooms only. No personal data.
